title: Project Overview
intro: Game-based Prediction × DAO Governance × Value Settlement
introDoc1: The first Gamified DAO Prediction Platform built on the MOVA ecosystem.
introDoc2: An incubated project of the MOVA × USD1Swap Hackathon
introDoc3: Backed by USD 1,000,000 in USD1 strategic funding
introDoc4: We compress prediction, decision-making, and capital flow
introDoc5:
Into a single, unified game environment.
No matter the outcome,
Value is never eliminated. It is only redistributed.
HunterDoc: Your gateway into battles, predictions, and system-level value flows
HunterText1: NFTs are long-term participation and revenue-capture credentials.
HunterText2: Every Hunter is a system asset.
HunterText4: Every distribution flows directly to you.
gameModel1Text1: A low-barrier entry point into battles and value flows.
gameModel1Text2: Anyone holding any NFT can participate.
gameModel1Text3: Designed to train DAO decision skills
gameModel1Text6: It is a progressive participation path where every action compounds into experience and value.
gameModel2ext2: Players are matched in real time. Results are settled on-chain.
gameModel2ext3: Every match is a direct test of judgment and strategy.
gameModel2ext5: Outcomes are driven by skill × randomness.
gameModel2ext6: Winning is not the only value.
gameModel2ext7: Every action leaves behind accumulatable, claimable system value.
gameModel3ext1: Built around verifiable events and data.
gameModel3ext8: Results directly shape DAO resource allocation
PointsDoc1: Boost is not a reward. It is your mining weight.
PointsDoc2: Boost Points are the core behavioral metric in Bounty Hunter.
PointsDoc3: They do not directly represent value. They determine how much value you receive every day.
PointsDoc4: This system rewards time + behavior, not referrals or hype.
PointsDoc5: Every action increases your Boost weight.
allianceDoc1: The Alliance Layer is the behavior aggregation and value-distribution engine of Bounty Hunter.
allianceDoc2: This is not a partnership list.
allianceDoc3: It is a computable, on-chain revenue-sharing layer.
allianceDoc4: Each Alliance can operate its own battle zone inside Bounty Hunter.
allianceDoc5: Alliances are not passive traffic diversion, but possess their own battleground.
allianceDoc7: External communities and projects do not just get exposure.
allianceDoc8:
They bring real users, real volume, and real behavior into the system
And earn directly from the value they generate.
